_metadata.source: Contextual inference from resource 0039_type15.bin party/equipment menu messages
_metadata.method: Japanese language analysis of partially-decoded menu text, cross-referenced with English guide (guide_full.txt) and known Busin 0 / Wizardry game mechanics
_metadata.resource_purpose: Party management, equipment, and knight order (騎士団) menu system

855.evidence: Msgs 54,56,58-64: 変[855] consistently forms 変更 (change/modify). Msgs 56: 騎士団の変更を行いますか？ (Will you change the knight order?). 変更 is the standard menu term for 'change/modify'.

367.evidence: Msgs 47,56: [367]いますか？ forms 行いますか？ (Will you carry out...?). Msg 47: [656]が[421]隊を[367]いますか？ = ○が○隊を行いますか？. Standard polite form 行う (to carry out/perform).

421.evidence: Msgs 34,45,47,48,49,51: [421]隊 forms 編隊 (formation/squad). But more likely: these messages about party assembly suggest 編成 pattern, where [421] before 隊 = 編. Msg 34: 編隊しますか？ Msg 49: 編隊しました. Party formation menu term.

647.evidence: Msg 1: [647]う = 使う (to use). Msg 19: ここでは[647]えません = ここでは使えません (cannot use here). Msg 50: 今すぐ[647][490]しますか = 今すぐ使用しますか？ (Will you use it right now?). Msg 85: 誰に使用しますか？ (On whom will you use it?). 281 is also mapped to 使 - likely different font size variant (menu vs dialogue text). The MSG system uses multiple font sheets.
647.note: Duplicate of 281=使. Different glyph IDs for same character in different font size contexts is normal for this game's encoding.

332.evidence: Msgs 2,26,28: [332][602] consistently appears in equipment context. [332][602] = 装備 (equipment). Msg 26: 装備できません (cannot equip). Msg 28: 装備をししますがよろしいですか？ = likely 装備を外しますがよろしいですか？ (Will you remove equipment?).

602.evidence: Always paired with [332] as [332][602] = 装備 (equipment/equip). Standard RPG menu term.

775.evidence: Msgs 7,15,16,29: [775][428] consistently appears. Msg 15: が[775][428]しています = が回復しています (is recovering/healed). Msg 16: [775][428]しました = 回復しました (recovered). Msg 29: [775][428]できる[287]がいません = 回復できる○がいません (no one who can recover). 回復 (recovery/healing) is standard RPG term.

428.evidence: Always paired with [775] as [775][428] = 回復 (recovery). See evidence for 775.

605.evidence: Msg 6: [605]てる = 持てる (can hold/carry). Msg 13: [543][544]に[605]てますか？ = ○○に持てますか？ (Can you carry it to...?). 持つ (to hold/carry) is standard inventory term.

619.evidence: Msgs 20,40,41: [619][620] appears as a 2-char compound. Msg 20: を[619][620]した = を攻撃した (attacked) or を獲得した (acquired). Given this is equipment/party menu, 獲得 (acquisition) fits better. However, 1121 is already mapped to 攻.

620.evidence: Paired with [619]. If [619]=攻, then [620]=撃 (攻撃=attack). But in party/equipment context, [619][620]した could be 獲得した (acquired). If [619]=獲, then [620]=得.

621.evidence: Msgs 21,42,43,52: [621][351] consistently appears. Msg 21: が[621][351]された = が解除された (was removed/cancelled). Msg 52: どのオー[212][223][208]ーを[621][351]しますか？ = which order to 解除 (cancel/remove)?. 解除 (cancel/release) is standard menu term.

351.evidence: Always paired with [621] as [621][351] = 解除 (cancel/release/remove). See evidence for 621.

712.evidence: Msgs 22,25,51: [712]りません = 足りません (not enough/insufficient). Standard phrase for resource shortage in menus.

728.evidence: Msgs 5,30,46,79,82,83: [728]れ[800]える = 入れ替える (to swap/replace). Msg 46: アイテムを入れ替えました (swapped the item). Msg 30: 入れ替える品がありません (no items to swap). Msg 79: [728][276]アイテム = 入手アイテム (acquired item) if [276]=手. 入れ替える is the standard RPG menu term for equipment swapping.

800.evidence: Msgs 5,30,46,82,83: always follows [728]れ as [728]れ[800]え = 着替え (change equipment). 替える = to replace/swap.

707.evidence: Msgs 48,82,83,86,88: [707]んで = 選んで (choose/select). Msg 48: [854]み[421]わせを[707]んでください = 組み合わせを選んでください (please choose a combination). Msg 86: わたす[193][194][211][225]を[707]んでください = わたすアイテムを選んでください (please choose item to hand over). 選ぶ (to select) is standard menu term.

708.evidence: Msgs 82,83: [707][708]して = 選択して (select). [707]=選 + [708]=択 = 選択 (selection). Standard compound.

709.evidence: Msgs 25,88: [709][710]な = 必要な (necessary). Msg 25: [709][710]な[33][48]が[712]りません = 必要な○○が足りません (necessary XX is insufficient). 必要 (necessary) is standard.

710.evidence: Always paired with [709] as [709][710] = 必要 (necessary). See evidence for 709.

287.evidence: Msg 29: [775][428]できる[287]がいません = 回復できる者がいません (there is no one who can heal). 者 (person) is standard.

581.evidence: Msg 30: [728]れ[800]える[581]がありません = 着替える品がありません (there are no items to change into). 品 (goods/items). Could also be 物 (thing) but 412 is already 物.

543.evidence: Msg 13: [543][544]に[605]てますか？ = 仲間に持てますか？ (Can a companion carry it?). 仲間 (companion/ally) is standard RPG term.

544.evidence: Paired with [543] as [543][544] = 仲間 (companion). See evidence for 543.

656.evidence: Msgs 47,85: [656]が[421]隊を[367]いますか？ = 誰が編隊を行いますか？ (Who will form the party?). Msg 85: [656]に[647][490]しますか？ = 誰に使/買○しますか？ (To whom will you use/give?). 誰 (who) is standard question word.

370.evidence: Msg 45: [421]隊に[370][682]しました = 編隊に成功しました (party formation succeeded). [370][682] = 成功 (success). Standard term.

682.evidence: Paired with [370] as [370][682] = 成功 (success). See evidence for 370.

854.evidence: Msg 48: [854]み[421]わせを[707]んでください = 組み合わせを選んでください (please choose a combination). 組み合わせ (combination) is standard.

853.evidence: Msg 51: [421]隊く[853]が[712]りません = 編隊枠が足りません (not enough party slots). 枠 (frame/slot) is common for slot limitations. The く before [853] is suspicious though - may need reparse.
853.note: Could be 編隊の数が足りません (not enough party count) if parsed differently.

693.evidence: Msg 50: [693]すぐ[647][490]しますか？ = 今すぐ使/買○しますか？ (Will you do it right now?). 今すぐ (right now/immediately) is standard phrase.

490.evidence: Msg 50: 今すぐ[647][490]しますか？ If [647]=使, then [647][490] = 使用 (use). If [647]=買, then 買[490] doesn't form a word easily. This supports [647]=使 and [490]=用, forming 使用 (usage). Msg 85: [656]に[647][490]しますか？ = 誰に使用しますか？ (On whom will you use it?).

698.evidence: Msg 80: [698][969] standalone = 終了 (end/complete) as menu button label. Msg 84: アイテム確認を[698][969]します = アイテム確認を終了します (end item confirmation). Msg 24: 部隊を[698]えます = 部隊を終えます (finish the squad). 終了 is standard menu term for completion/ending.

508.evidence: Msg 24: [508]隊 = 部隊 (unit/squad). 部 is the standard prefix for 部隊. With 509=隊 already known.

443.evidence: Msg 53: 騎士団と[443][728][597]を[737]めてください = 騎士団と名前を決めてください (please decide the knight order and name). [443]=名 with [728]=着? No - msg 53 context: [443][728][597] should be 名前 (name) which is 2 chars. But [443][728][597] is 3 glyphs. Reconsidering: if [443]=名, then [443] alone = 名. But 名前 = [443][597] with [728] in between doesn't work. Let me reconsider: maybe [443][728][597] is not 名前. Could be 称号 or 旗印 (banner/emblem).
443.note: Needs more context. If [728]=着 as inferred elsewhere, then [443]着[597] doesn't form a clear word. May need reconsideration.

597.evidence: If msg 53 reads 騎士団と名前を決めてください, then [597]=前. But the sequence [443][728][597] has [728] in between. Reconsidering: Msg 53 could parse as 騎士団と○ ○○を○めてください where the subject is different. Msg 88: [709][710]な[597]を[707]んでいません = 必要な○を選んでいません (haven't selected the necessary XX). If [597]=数 (number), then 必要な数を選んでいません = haven't selected the necessary number.

737.evidence: Msg 53: [737]めてください = 決めてください (please decide). 決める (to decide) is standard.

572.evidence: Msg 33: [572]も[668]っていません = 何も持っていません (don't have anything). 何も (nothing/anything) is standard phrase.

668.evidence: Msg 33: [572]も[668]っていません = 何も持っていません (don't have anything). [668]っている = 持っている (to have/possess). But [605] is also inferred as 持. These could be the same character at different font sizes or a duplicate, or one of them is wrong.
668.note: Both 605 and 668 may map to 持 in different contexts, or one may be 待 (to wait) - but 753=待 is already mapped. Possibly 668=持 is correct and 605 is a different character.

839.evidence: Msg 4: [51][48]殿[839] could parse as ○○殿下 (Your Highness) - a form of address in royal/knightly context. 殿下 is a title used in Wizardry games.

849.evidence: Msg 18: 使いで[849][850]に[851]たされた = 使いで体力に満たされた (filled with physical strength through use). Alternatively [849][850] could be 元気 or another compound.

850.evidence: Paired with [849] in msg 18. If [849]=体, then [850]=力 forming 体力 (physical strength/HP). Common RPG term.

851.evidence: Msg 18: [851]たされた = 満たされた (was filled/satisfied). 満たす (to fill/satisfy) is standard.

666.evidence: Msg 77: [722][350][638][593]が[666]なる[316][776]は = ○○○○が異なる○○は (XX that differ in...). 異なる (to differ) is standard. In equipment context: items with different attributes.

507.evidence: Msg 89: [339][959]が[507]えた = ○○が増えた (XX increased). 増える (to increase) is standard.

339.evidence: Msg 89: [339][959]が[507]えた = 経験が増えた (experience increased). [339][959] = 経験 (experience) is standard RPG term.

959.evidence: Paired with [339] as [339][959] = 経験 (experience). See evidence for 339.

911.evidence: Msgs 81,84: [911][587] appears as a compound. Msg 81: [193][194][211][225]を[911][587]してください = アイテムを確認してください (please confirm the item). 確認 (confirmation) is standard menu term.

587.evidence: Paired with [911] as [911][587] = 確認 (confirm/verify). See evidence for 911.

969.evidence: Paired with [698] as [698][969] = 終了 (end/complete). Msg 80: standalone menu label. Msg 84: アイテム確認を終了します.

908.evidence: Msg 92: [836][989]の[908]り[597] = ○○の残り○ (remaining XX of...). 残り (remaining) is standard.

836.evidence: Msgs 90,91,92: [836][989] appears consistently. Msg 90: が騎士で[836][989]を明ています. Msg 91: [836][989]の[597]. Msg 92: [836][989]の[908]り[597]. Context suggests 所持 (possession) - 所持品 (possessions/belongings). [836]=所, [989]=持?
836.note: If [989]=持 then [836][989]=所持 (to possess). But already have 605 and 668 potentially as 持. In this case [989] might be a different character.

989.evidence: If [836][989]=所持, then [989]=持. But multiple glyphs mapping to 持 is unusual. Could be a different compound.

276.evidence: Msg 79: [728][276][193][194][211][225] = 入手アイテム (acquired item). [728]=入, [276]=手 forming 入手 (acquisition/obtaining). Standard RPG term for item acquisition.

278.evidence: Msg 75: [278]の使いでつけかえられません = 性の使いでつけかえられません. In equipment context, 性 (nature/gender/attribute) restriction. Could mean 'due to the attribute, cannot swap'. But 属性 (attribute) would be more natural as a 2-char compound.
278.note: Low context. Possibly 性別 (gender) related restriction.

316.evidence: Msg 76: [316][776]の使いでつけかえられません = 職業の使いでつけかえられません (cannot swap due to class/occupation). Msg 77: [666]なる[316][776]は = 異なる職業は (different classes). 職業 (occupation/class) is standard RPG term for character class.

776.evidence: Paired with [316] as [316][776] = 職業 (class/occupation). See evidence for 316.

365.evidence: Msg 78: [365][288][600]にできません = ○○○にできません (cannot make into XX). Context unclear.

288.evidence: Msg 78: [365][288][600]にできません. If [365]=両 and [288]=手, then 両手○ (two-handed XX). 両手持ち (two-handed grip) or 両手装備 (two-handed equip) could be referenced.

600.evidence: Msg 78: [365][288][600]にできません. If preceding is 両手, then [600]=持 forming 両手持ちにできません (cannot be two-handed).
600.note: Very speculative, multiple glyphs for 持 would be unusual.

436.evidence: Msg 93: 使いが殿かれ[436]け[941]った = likely 使いが解かれ抜け落った or similar. [436]け = 抜け (slip out/remove). Context: 'the spell/enchantment was released and fell away'.

941.evidence: Msg 93: [436]け[941]った. If [436]=抜, then 抜け[941]った. 408=落 is already mapped. Could be a different character.
941.note: 408 is already 落. If [941] is also 落, that's unusual but possible for different font variants.

704.evidence: Msgs 40-43: appear in stat change context. [619][620][704][700] and [621][351][704][700] = acquisition/removal of stat values. [704] could be 値 (value) in stat context.

700.evidence: Appears with [704] in msgs 40-43. If these are item stat displays, could be part of value/level indicators.

767.evidence: Msg 8: この[767][768]でよろしいですか？ = この内容でよろしいですか？ (Is this content/choice OK?). 内容 (content/details) is standard confirmation phrase.

768.evidence: Paired with [767] as [767][768] = 内容 (content). See evidence for 767.

535.evidence: Msgs 60,67: [535][717] appears as a 2-char class name. In Wizardry, 忍者 (Ninja) is a 2-char class. [535]=忍, [717]=者.

717.evidence: Paired with [535] as [535][717] = 忍者 (Ninja). Note: 287 was also inferred as 者. Multiple IDs for same char could indicate different font/size variants or one inference is wrong.
717.note: If 287=者 from msg 29, and 717=者 from class names, this is unusual. Alternatively [717] could be a different character.

346.evidence: Msgs 59,62,66: [346] appears as a single-character class name. In Wizardry, 侍 (Samurai) is the only single-character class name. Msg 59: [0][346]に変更. Msg 66: [346]が.

308.evidence: Msgs 61,68: [308][354][320] is a 3-char class name. In Busin 0, 修道僧 (Monk) is the 3-char class. But [308]≠修. Alternatively 僧侶 is 2 chars. Let me reconsider: if classes with 3 chars include 魔法使 (without い), 錬金術, 暗黒騎, etc.
308.note: Needs more investigation. The 3-char classes in Japanese Wizardry are uncertain.

582.evidence: Msgs 63,70: [582][719][590] is a 3-char class name. Could be 暗黒騎 (Dark Knight prefix) but 暗黒騎士 is 4 chars. Or this could be a different 3-char compound.

719.evidence: If [582]=暗, paired as 暗黒 (darkness). See 582.

590.evidence: If [582][719][590] = 暗黒騎 (dark knight), then [590]=騎. But 280=騎 is already mapped.
590.note: 280=騎 already exists. Could be 士 instead - 暗黒士 but that's not standard. Reconsidering the class identification.

720.evidence: Msgs 64,71: [720][721][590] is a 3-char class name. If these are advanced classes, [720][721][590] could be 聖騎士 (Paladin/Holy Knight) with [720]=聖, [721]=騎, [590]=士. But 280=騎 already.
720.note: Speculative. The font may have duplicate kanji at different glyph IDs for different usage contexts.

718.evidence: Msgs 62,69: [718][696][346] is a 3-char class name containing [346]=侍. Could be 義○侍. In Wizardry, 義賊 (Gizoku) is a class, but it would be [718][696] = 義賊 + [346]=侍 which doesn't form a standard class name.
718.note: Needs reconsideration of class name assignments.

696.evidence: If [718]=義, paired as 義賊 (Gizoku). But the 3-char sequence [718][696][346] would need explanation.

722.evidence: Msg 77: [722][350][638][593]が[666]なる[316][776]は = 属性○○が異なる職業は (classes with different attributes...). [722][350] could be 属性 (attribute type).

350.evidence: If [722]=属, then [722][350]=属性 (attribute). But 278 was also tentatively 性.
350.note: Multiple IDs for 性 is unusual but possible.

638.evidence: Msg 77 context suggests equipment restrictions. [638][593] could be 制限 (restriction).
